resources.string: PhonePilot uses this accessibility service exclusively for authorized on-device UI automation and inspection when explicitly enabled by the user. It can detect visible screen components, navigate between apps, and execute configured user actions. PhonePilot does not collect, store, or transmit sensitive personal passwords or payment data.
Notifications regarding device connectivity, background heartbeat, and automation health status.
Notifications for task execution results, alerts, and scheduled workflows.
